primary.procedure: 256-key self-test over aappleby/smhasher's MurmurHash3.cpp: for key length i in 0..255, key = bytes [0,1,...,i-1], hash = murmur3_32_bytes(key, seed = 256 - i); write each hash little-endian into a 1024-byte buffer at offset i*4; final = murmur3_32_bytes(buffer, seed = 0); expected 0xB0F57EE3.
